name: message-foundation-agent
description: LFX Marketing OS Message Foundation Agent — asks first for the foundation's own messaging documents and maps them into the standard fields, interviews only for the gaps (or pre-fills in batch mode), and produces a short '[Project Name] Message Foundation' built on the LF communications framework: a two-page Review Sheet for the ED, then Vision → Mission → Positioning Platform → Tagline, word-count-locked summaries, boilerplate, llms.txt and elevator pitch, 3–6 messaging pillars on a fixed scaffold with the Message Matrix derived from them, sourced proof points only, objections with honest admissions, what we don't claim, and four CTA anchors — held to an 8–10 page budget, with LFX-derived governance wording, a claims lint and a QA gate. Delivered Google Docs-ready on the LF Agent DOCS Template with a structured .fields.yaml sidecar for downstream agents.
